body_ar:
لقد امتن الله على البشرية ببعثة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، فأخرجها به من الظلمات إلى النور، وقد قام صلى الله عليه وسلم بتربية أصحابه تربية تؤهلهم لخدمة الدين والقيام بأعبائه، وتحقيق مطالبه والتعاون على نصرته، ونحن اليوم نعيش غربة الإسلام آخر الزمان، فينبغي على كل مسلم منا أن ينصر الإسلام، ويؤازر الصالحين بقدر إمكانه، لعل الله يلحقنا بالجيل الرباني الأول.
إغاثة الله للأمة بالإسلام بعد الجاهلية:
الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه، ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين أما بعد: فإن الله سبحانه وتعالى ختم الأمم بهذه الأمة المشرفة العظيمة التي جعلها خير أمة أخرجت للناس، وشرفها بأنواع التشريف، فأرسل إليها أفضل الرسل، وأنزل عليها أفضل الكتب، وشرع لها خير شرائع الدين. وقد جعل الله سبحانه وتعالى أهل هذه الأمة شهوداً على الناس عدولاً، فقال تعالى: وَكَذَلِكَ جَعَلْنَاكُمْ أُمَّةً وَسَطًا لِتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًا.[البقرة:143] ...
body_en:
*[Site synopsis]* God conferred a favour upon humankind in sending Muhammad, God bless him and grant him peace, and through him brought humankind out of the darknesses into the light. He, God bless him and grant him peace, undertook the formation of his Companions — a formation that made them fit to serve the religion, to carry its burdens, to meet its demands and to cooperate in supporting it. Today we live the estrangement of Islam at the end of time, so every Muslim among us ought to support Islam and to stand by the righteous so far as he is able, in the hope that God will join us to the first God-devoted generation.

## God's rescue of the community through Islam after the age of ignorance

Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds. I ask God's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his Companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the Day of Judgement. To proceed: God, glorified and exalted is He, sealed the nations with this honoured and mighty community, which He made the best community brought forth for mankind, and which He ennobled with every kind of ennoblement. He sent to it the best of the messengers, sent down upon it the best of the books, and laid down for it the best of the revealed codes of the religion. And God, glorified and exalted is He, has made the people of this community witnesses over mankind, upright in their testimony, for He, exalted is He, said: {And thus We made you a middle community, that you may be witnesses over mankind and that the Messenger may be a witness over you} (Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:143) …

It breaks off on an ellipsis immediately after the first Qur'anic citation, before the announced subject — the rescue of the community through Islam after the age of ignorance — is addressed at all. The complete text sits behind /medias/doc/c-c-25.doc. The English ends exactly where the Arabic ends and completes nothing. Must not be rendered as a whole lesson.

flags.context: the title, and the closing words of the site's synopsis
flags.note: 'رباني' is an adjective from 'رب' (Lord) and carries both 'belonging wholly to the Lord' and 'formed and taught by the Lord' — the second sense is live here because the synopsis is about the Prophet's formation of his Companions. No single English word holds both. 'Divinely guided' was avoided because it imports a claim about guidance the Arabic does not make. The Arabic is kept in brackets so the term is recoverable.

options: the estrangement of Islam at the end of time
the strangeness of Islam in the last age
Islam's return to being a stranger at the end of time
flags.note: 'غربة' alludes to the well-known report that Islam began as a stranger and will return as a stranger. The synopsis does not quote the report or attribute it, and no attribution has been added. 'Estrangement' keeps the noun abstract as the Arabic has it.

translator_notes: One of a run of six records, IDs 701-706, in the written-da'wah section, all uploaded on 9 May 2011 within about twenty minutes of one another, all built to the same template and all excerpts. Each carries a site-written synopsis, then a section heading, then the opening formula and the first lines of a lesson, and then breaks off on an ellipsis; the full text sits behind a .doc download in the /medias/doc/c-c-* series. The uniform timestamps are a bulk upload and say nothing about when the lesson was delivered.

The record contains two distinct voices and the English keeps them apart. The opening paragraph is a synopsis written by the site, about the lesson and in the third person; everything from the section heading onward is the Sheikh's own words as transcribed. Nothing in the synopsis may be quoted as his.

The source's final line, 'تحميل المادة' ('download the material'), is the label of a download link in the page furniture, not part of the text. It is recorded as source_download_link and omitted from body_ar and body_en.
Qur'anic renderings here are interpretive and are not a substitute for the Arabic.
No ruling term appears anywhere in the record.

'شهوداً على الناس عدولاً' is rendered 'witnesses over mankind, upright in their testimony'. 'عدول' is the technical term for witnesses whose probity is established, and it qualifies 'شهوداً'; it is not a second, separate description.
